what_this_is: Flock Safety ALPR cameras as mapped in OpenStreetMap on 2026-09-26. Not a count of cameras that exist.
quantisation_note: lat = lat_q / quantisation, lon = lon_q / quantisation, WGS84 decimal degrees. 1e-5 deg is about 1.1 m of latitude.
direction_note: Degrees clockwise from true north, 0 = due north. -1 means the camera carries no usable direction tag — it does NOT mean north.
state_note: st[i] indexes states[]; -1 means the camera is not inside any US county.
order: sorted by lat_q, then lon_q, then OSM id — stable across runs
